· 거래량 비율 (0.51배) — 5일 평균 대비 위축

analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current Price (KRW 95,070) vs SMA5/20/50 (KRW 90,152 / 121,705 / 167,019) — Above SMA5, below SMA20/50
· Position vs SMA100/200 (KRW 136,749 / 96,384) — Below SMA100, near SMA200
· 52-week Position (31.2%) + Current price level near historical lows
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI Trajectory (39.6 → 40.2) — Staying in neutral zone, attempting to exit oversold
· MACD Histogram Trajectory (-2445.6648 → -1535.2735) — Improving in negative territory, weak signal for trend reversal
· Bollinger Band Current Price Position (Middle Band KRW 121,705) — Sideways near the middle band
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing Support (KRW 68,045) — High level relative to Pivot S1 (KRW 43,880)
· Swing Resistance (KRW 95,500) — Near current price, short-term bounce expected on breakout
· 5-day/20-day High/Low Pattern (Higher Low needs confirmation) — Entering sideways range
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume Ratio (0.51x) — Contracted compared to 5-day average
· Current Phase Diagnosis (Accumulation Zone) — Observe and await confirmation of resistance breakout at KRW 95,500
analysis.patternNote: 직전 3거래일간의 급등락 이후 현재는 5일 저가 대비 5일 고가가 높아지는 'Higher Low' 패턴의 초입으로 보이나, 거래량 위축으로 추세 전환을 확신하기는 어렵다.
analysis.patternNoteEn: Following sharp fluctuations over the past 3 sessions, the pattern appears to be at the start of a 'Higher Low', but the contraction in volume makes a trend reversal uncertain.
keyPoints: RSI 과매도 탈출 후 중립 구간 유지, MACD 개선 미흡으로 추세 전환 신호 약함
거래량 비율 0.51로 위축, 5일 연속 변동성 구간에서 추가 확인 필요
스윙 저항선 95,500원 근접, 돌파 시 매수 관점 전환 가능성
keyPointsEn: RSI exited oversold and remains neutral, MACD improvement is weak, signaling an uncertain trend reversal.
Volume ratio at 0.51 indicates contraction, requiring further confirmation in this volatile 5-day period.
Approaching swing resistance at KRW 95,500; a breakout could shift the view to a buy signal.
analysis.riskNote: ADX 30.4로 뚜렷한 추세가 형성되었으나, -DI(33.8)가 +DI(18.4)보다 높아 하락 압력이 우위에 있어 급락 가능성을 경계해야 한다.
analysis.riskNoteEn: ADX at 30.4 indicates a clear trend, but the higher -DI (33.8) vs +DI (18.4) suggests downward pressure, warranting caution against sharp declines.
analysis.continuity: 직전 4거래일 연속 관망 판독이 이어지고 있다. 금일 RSI는 과매도 구간을 탈출했으나 MACD 개선이 미흡하고 거래량이 위축되어 관망세를 유지한다.
analysis.continuityEn: The wait-and-see read has now held for 4 straight sessions. Today, RSI exited oversold but MACD improvement is insufficient and volume is contracted, thus maintaining the wait-and-see stance.
